page.overview:
Who is Loomis?

Captain Loomis was a 24th century Starfleet officer who served in the Dominion War.

After the Federation Alliance captured the Chin'toka system in 2374, Loomis and his crew were assigned to protect a Dominion communication array on AR-558. He was later killed by the Jem'Hadar, as was his second in command, Commander . ()
